# Vendored browser libraries

These browser distributions are kept in the site so the static portfolio can work without a build step or a runtime CDN.

- Three.js 0.187.0: MIT. License text is in `three/LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- GSAP 3.15.1 and ScrollTrigger: GreenSock's standard no-charge license. License terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license. Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- Lenis 1.3.27: MIT. License text is in `lenis/LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
